text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian emerged victorious in the 
Kikuka Sho. Running like the true 
"Monster" that she was, she became a 
Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Hishi Amazon had achieved the 
Triple Tiara. True to their promise, the 
two reaffirmed their determination to face 
off at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian sets her sights on the Arima 
Kinen. To settle the score with Hishi 
Amazon—!
